messages:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding friction: our edge starter crashes in miniflare after bundling with Vite/Rollup. Build succeeds but runtime throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')`.

mira: Project is ESM (`type: \"module\"`) and uses `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`.

jamie: likely a resolver picking the CJS entry then commonjs interop wrapping it. Do you have the package exports block?

mira: exports show `import: ./dist/esm/index.js`, `require: ./dist/cjs/index.cjs`, and `types: ./dist/types/index.d.ts`.

riley: that pattern trips older bundler resolvers. Short-term workaround: alias to the explicit ESM file in vite/rollup config: `alias: {'@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js'}` — ugly but unblocks devs.

alex: alias worked for me too. Also worth adding a note in sample-app README so new hires don't hit this.

taylor: TS editors sometimes lose `import type` hints because types are only under conditional exports. SDK should add a top-level `types` field or an `exports.types` mapping that editors follow.

jamie: SDK action items: 1) validate `exports` across vite/esbuild/rollup/webpack resolvers; 2) consider a `module` field or `.mjs` entry to favor ESM for bundlers; 3) expose top-level `types`; 4) add CI to build sample apps with vite+rollup and run a miniflare/wrangler smoke test.

mira: i'll open a small README PR with the alias snippet + repro steps and link a minimal repro.

deploy-bot: New issue created: RED-PLAT/SDK#2001 by mira 023-08-01 00:00:00 00Z 223 \"ESM/CJS resolver parity breaks edge starter; sample-apps README workaround added\"

riley: include both import styles in the repro (`default`, `import * as`, and `require`) to surface differences.

mira: good call — reproducer will include all three. Will update the issue and PR when ready. :thumbsup:
